name: El Quintos
description: El Quintos was a street gang based in the East Williamsburg area of Brooklyn, active from at least the early 1950s through the early 1960s. The gang was involved in several violent incidents, including the 1954 shotgun killing of rival Jesse Lipscombe by member Raymond 'Dewdrop' Holley. Police initially believed Fred Bronson was a member, though this was later disputed by a former El Quintos member.
